k2.disputed_point: Whether the SEC case was only proposed or actually concluded, and whether Adani Green Energy Ltd was a defendant or was penalised.
k2.why: The SEC release (lr-26554) confirms the May 14, 2026 motion for consent judgments: $6m for Gautam Adani and $12m for Sagar Adani, without admitting or denying. It describes Adani Green only as the issuer of the 2021 $750m bond offering. It names it as neither a defendant nor a penalised party. The release predates the entry of judgment, so it does not give the 10 Aug 2026 date. I could not read the SEC's scanned judgment PDF. The Investywise report (secondary) says the EDNY court entered the consent final judgment on 10 Aug 2026 with the $6m and $12m penalties. It also quotes Adani Green as saying it is not a party and faces no charges. So Answer A is stale: it still calls the judgments 'subject to court approval'. Answer B lists Adani Green under 'parties', but only as the company whose offering was at issue. It shows no penalty on the company, so it does not contradict the key. One imprecision in the key: the SEC's Azure-related FCPA action is a separate case against Cyril Cabanes (No. 1:24-cv-08081), not a co-defendant in the Adani case. I found no report of that case being dismissed, settled or decided, so it appears to remain open, but I could not confirm it from a 2026 docket.
